rule: Names are compared after removing format characters (Unicode category Cf, such as the zero-width space and the soft hyphen), NFKC normalization, case folding and collapsing runs of whitespace. A composed and a decomposed accent, a double space and an invisible character therefore make no new name: such an alias repeats the canonical name, is shared with another substance, or is another substance's name, and is dropped as those rules say.
